title: Sections of a single-map restriction-adjunction lift
statement: Let p:Y→X be any scheme map, I and J injective resolutions of arbitrary modules on X and Y, and t:I→p_*J a complex map. Let U⊆X and W=p⁻¹U. Let A and B be restricted resolution choices of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] on U and W. Construct b and its restriction-adjunction lift k as in the Lean let-expression, using the restriction unit on J and the pushforward composition and congruence comparisons. For every section isomorphism a:Γ(W,B)≅Γ(U,h_*B) with inverse equal degreewise to restriction along h⁻¹top=top, one has Γ(U,k)≫a.inv≫B.sections.hom=A.sections.hom≫t(U). This statement concerns only one map p and does not mention a cartesian square, flatness, flatBaseChangeResolutionQ, or transport between the two projection inverse images.

proof.text: For an arbitrary scheme map p:Y→X and open U⊆X, set W=p⁻¹U and h=p|W. Use the restriction unit on the target complex, the pushforward composition/congruence comparisons and the inverse target resolution comparison to construct b:I→U.ι_*h_*B. Set k to the restriction adjoint of b precomposed with the source comparison. This is exactly the let-expression in the Lean statement and uses no choice of data.

Evaluate k in each degree. The restriction adjunction counit is presheaf restriction along U.ι⁻¹(U.ι(top))=top. Evaluate the unit on the target complex as restriction from p⁻¹(U.ι(top)) to W.ι(W.ι⁻¹(p⁻¹(U.ι(top)))). Pushforward composition comparisons are identities on sections; the congruence comparison restricts along the equality of inverse-image opens furnished by h≫U.ι=W.ι≫p.

Naturality moves B.comparison.inv across the counit restriction and the given a.inv restriction. Expand B.sections.hom using B.components. The inverse and forward target comparison cancel degreewise. Combine the remaining presheaf maps; using U.ι(top)=U and W.ι(top)=W gives the canonical restriction identification. Expand A.components and move t across the source restriction by naturality. Thus Γ(k)≫a.inv≫B.sections.hom=A.sections.hom≫t(U). Degreewise extensionality gives the complex identity. No augmentation or flatness is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictionResolutionLift_sections {X Y : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (p : Y ⟶ X) {M : X.Modules} {N : Y.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution M) (J : InjectiveResolution N)
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward p).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (U : X.Opens) (A : RestrictedResolutionSections I U)
    (B : RestrictedResolutionSections J (p ⁻¹ᵁ U)) :
  let W := p ⁻¹ᵁ U
  letI : (restrictFunctor U.ι).Additive :=
    (restrictAdjunction U.ι).left_adjoint_additive
  let h := p.resLE U W le_rfl
  let C := B.resolution.cocomplex
  let P := (pushforward U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let H := (pushforward h).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let G := (pushforward p).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let e₁ := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (pushforwardComp W.ι p)
    (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let e₂ := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
    (pushforwardCongr (p.resLE_comp_ι (U := U) (V := W) le_rfl))
    (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let e₃ := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (pushforwardComp h U.ι) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let w := ((restrictAdjunction W.ι).unit.mapHomologicalComplex
    (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).app J.cocomplex
  let b : I.cocomplex ⟶ P.obj (H.obj C) :=
    t ≫ G.map w ≫ e₁.hom.app (((restrictFunctor W.ι).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) ≫
      e₂.inv.app (((restrictFunctor W.ι).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) ≫
      e₃.inv.app (((restrictFunctor W.ι).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) ≫
      P.map (H.map B.comparison.inv)
  let k := A.comparison.hom ≫
    (((restrictAdjunction U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homEquiv
      I.cocomplex (H.obj C)).symm b
  let ΓS := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace ⋙
    forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  let ΓT := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.toRingedSpace ⋙
    forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
  ∀ (a : ΓT.obj B.resolution.cocomplex ≅ ΓS.obj (H.obj B.resolution.cocomplex)),
    (∀ n : ℕ, a.inv.f n = (B.resolution.cocomplex.X n).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (by simp) : (⊤ : (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) ⟶
        h ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)).op) →
    ΓS.map k ≫ a.inv ≫ B.sections.hom =
      A.sections.hom ≫
        ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace U).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map t
